keyswitch.configuration.title: Key Switch
How long a shared key must be held before scrolling the wheel opens the switcher card; holding the key alone does nothing, so hold-to-activate mods keep working
keyswitch.configuration.workInsideGui.to: Holding a key inside an inventory or chest screen still opens the panel; text fields always keep priority
keyswitch.configuration.mouseButtonLongP: Holding a mouse button opens the panel too. When off, mouse button conflicts can only be switched from the overview
keyswitch.configuration.swallowHeldTrigg: Off by default: presses on a shared key are left untouched, so press-to-trigger and hold-to-activate mods behave normally (the current binding fires once before you scroll). Turn it on to swallow the key while held so nothing on it fires, at the cost of taps firing on release and hold-to-activate bindings breaking
keyswitch.configuration.pauseWhileChoosi: The panel pauses singleplayer like a regular inventory screen
keyswitch.configuration.protectedBinding: These bindings are never replaced by an unbound key, and a key carrying any of them never opens the switcher on long press - use the overview key instead. Binding names such as key.jump
Print which binding is active after switching, on the HUD and in chat
keyswitch.configuration.showConflictHint: Print how many shared keys were found into chat when entering a world
